title: Axios 403 error with file uploader when site is embedded in Iframe
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

Getting error **AxiosError: Request failed with status code 403** while uploading file with streamlit file uploader component embedded in Iframe. I have disabled CORS as stated in previously raised tickets in forum but the error is still there. The component is working fine if the file is uploaded outside Iframe. The app is deployed in Azure web app.

![image003](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6f584edf-6b47-4b85-adf0-d3c67f4b44d8)

One thing that I have noticed is the _streamlit_xsrf_ cookie is acting differently in standalone site and in an iframe.
In iframe I can see two entries in cookie with 2nd entry throwing error.

![image004](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0563037b-c8d1-41db-ad79-accb632f7ff2)


_This Set-Cookie header didn't specify a "SameSite" attribute and was defaulted to "SameSite=Lax," and was blocked because it came from a cross-site response which was not the response to a top-level navigation. The Set-Cookie had to have been set with "SameSite=None" to enable cross-site usage._

In the standalone site where the component is working fine, I can see only the first entry of the cookie, there is no 2nd entry.

Yep, it is an interesting point, we work on making this experience better. 
It is not secure, but if your app operates in the trusted perimeter, you can set both 
```toml
[server]
enableCORS = true
enableXsrfProtection = true
```

That would not check for CSRF tokens for file uploading, and it then would work when the streamlit app is embedded.
